quote: DP World has inaugurated a major expansion at its Posorja terminal, part of a USD $190 million private investment that strengthens Ecuador’s trade infrastructure … The project extends the terminal’s quay to 700 meters (an addition of 232.5 meters) enabling the simultaneous handling of two post-Panamax vessels at full capacity. By the end of 2026, the berth will reach 800 meters in length, increasing annual throughput capacity to 1.4 million twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs).
note: Opened DP World English primary 2026-10-04; USD 190m / 700 m quay (+232.5 m) / 1.4m TEU / dual post-Panamax / electric Super Post-Panamax cranes confirmed. CapEx-fill upgrade from prior USD 140m.
